summary: Sculptor Diversified Real Estate Income Trust filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its September 30, 2026 net asset value per share. Total NAV was $696.0 million across 60,809,681 shares/units, or $11.4459 per unit. Class-level NAVs ranged from $11.0166 (Class I-S) to $11.7443 (Class E), with Classes F, FF, AA and A at $11.4159, $11.2669, $11.1555 and $11.0471 respectively. This is a routine periodic NAV/valuation disclosure for a non-traded REIT, not a special situation; no transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are present.
